summary: Iteration 24: per-chamber water meters, usage date-range (+xlsx), rearing cycles (Nowe wstawienie / Zakończ chów / history). Backend pytest 9/9 pass (state water fields, range structure + growth over 35s, 422 on invalid dates, other-farm 404, xlsx sheets Podsumowanie/Dni with chamber names, cycle start/409/422 future/404 bad chamber/403 viewer/list with days+water+kwh/end/409 re-end/events text). Frontend at 390x844: cycle card with water l/min, form defaults to today, cancel, save -> active card (Od 2026-10-01 · dzień 21, 420 szt., water m³, Wpisał(a) email), end with confirm -> history row; viewer sees no cycle-new/cycle-end but sees active cycle + history toggle. Dane tab: range-from=2026-10-01 / range-to=today defaults, range-show displays kWh, total water and 6 rows using custom chamber name ('Porodówka TEST'), range-xlsx href returns 200 xlsx with correct filename; Dane events log contains 'nowe wstawienie' and 'koniec chowu'.

minor.issue: Single-active-cycle check is find_one-then-insert (no unique partial index on device_id+chamber where end=null) - two concurrent POSTs could create two active cycles. Low risk.

design_issues.screen: Dane tab (pre-existing, made heavier by new card)
issues: Main thread nearly saturated on Dane view (~3.3s of long tasks per 3s; evaluate roundtrip 0.8-2.5s vs 0.01s on Komory). Playwright native clicks time out there; JS clicks work. Cause: DataView re-renders 5 Recharts charts (3h history) on every WS state tick with no memoization. Suggest React.memo on Chart / useMemo for data, or throttle history updates. Partially amplified by preview instrumentation, but worth fixing for low-end phones.
Native <input type=date> used (browser default picker) instead of shadcn calendar - acceptable on mobile PWA but inconsistent with design guideline

'Zużycie dzienne (7 dni)' chart shows ~33 kWh / ~5.7 m³ today while the new range card shows 0.74 kWh / 0.10 m³ for the same month - different data sources (range only accumulates since meter sampler started today). Expected now, but users may be confused until data accrues.
